name: Terminal Session
description: Lets a person talk to the hub in a plain terminal: each line goes through the front door, the work summary and any question are drawn, and the next line answers an open question.
purpose: Let a person converse with the hub in a plain terminal and always see what it is doing and what it asks.
approach: Read a line, send it to the front door it is given, draw the events of the run with the terminal blocks, and treat the next line as the answer while a question is open.
out_of_scope: How a run is answered (the front door), how a block is worded and drawn (the terminal blocks), where a typed answer is sent beyond the next message, and any screen that needs a UI library.
milestones: 1. Let a person converse with the hub in a plain terminal and always see what it is doing and what it asks. (authoritative metric metric-terminal-session).
measures_of_success: Let a person converse with the hub in a plain terminal and always see what it is doing and what it asks.
inputs: Lines of text, a front door that answers one input, and a text stream to write to.
outputs: The exit code, and the text written: the answers, the summary of the work and any question.
effects: Reads lines until the person quits, input ends or the person interrupts, and writes to the stream it is given.
usage_notes: `ahohs chat` runs it over the whole hub; the how-to is docs/how-to/talk-to-the-hub-in-a-terminal.md.
change_driver: how people want to talk to the hub from a terminal
